$comment: Team-wide, non-secret settings. Secrets never live in this repo; see docs/KEYS.md.

team.$comment: Confirmed by Yu from developer.apple.com Membership details on 2026-10-20. A Team ID is public (it appears in every signed app); it is not a secret.

appStoreConnect.$comment: Only the GitHub Actions backup route and API scripting need a key. Xcode Cloud signs without one. Key ID and issuer ID live in ~/.config/orchard/asc.json (0600), the .p8 in the login Keychain.
